verdict.rationale: Wave ships several fixed-purpose background automations that run on their own once set up: overdue reminders scheduled at 3, 7 and 14 days after the due date, recurring invoices with automatic card payments, auto-imported and auto-categorized bank transactions, and automatic payroll tax filing. These are genuine recurring schedules, not one-off actions. However, they are preset features with a few options, not a general automation builder, and several are Pro-only. missing for 10: user-definable custom automation rules or workflows, triggers and actions beyond invoicing, bank feeds and payroll, any documented API or webhook surface for building automations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule reminders to automatically deploy 3, 7, and 14 days after sent invoices are due, so you don't have to keep chasing customers.
Set up recurring invoices and automatic credit card payments for your repeat customers and stop chasing payments.
With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
Wave’s complete payroll tax service will automatically pay and file your state and federal payroll taxes.
